array.string: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; URLF=/tmp/crossade-table-url; TS=/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale; put() { echo "туннель стола: $1"; if [ "$(cat $URLF 2>/dev/null)" != "$1" ]; then echo "$1" > $URLF; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.crossade.table || true; fi; }; FUN=$($TS funnel status 2>/dev/null | grep "(Funnel on)" | grep -o "https://[a-z0-9.-]*\.ts\.net" | head -1); outside() { H=${FUN#https://}; IP=$(dig +short @1.1.1.1 $H A | tail -1); [ -n "$IP" ] && [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} --max-time 10 --resolve $H:443:$IP $FUN/health)" = 200 ]; }; if [ -n "$FUN" ] && outside; then put "$FUN"; miss=0; while [ $miss -lt 3 ]; do sleep 60; if outside; then miss=0; else miss=$((miss+1)); fi; done; echo "Funnel не отвечает снаружи — перехожу на запасной"; exit 0; fi; [ -n "$FUN" ] && echo "Funnel включён, но снаружи не отвечает — беру запасной"; LOG=/tmp/crossade-table-tunnel.log; : > $LOG; cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:2590 --no-autoupdate > $LOG 2>&1 & T=$!; trap "kill $T" EXIT; URL=; for i in $(seq 60); do sleep 1; URL=$(grep -o "https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com" $LOG | grep -v "^https://api\." | tail -1); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; done; [ -n "$URL" ] || exit 1; put "$URL"; wait $T
